target.body:
Bumps [github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2](https://github.com/pelletier/go-toml) from 2.4.2 to 2.4.3.
Release notes

Sourced from github.com/pelletier/go-toml/v2's releases.

v2.4.3

What's Changed

What's new

  • Add RawMessage marshal support to unstable by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1084

Fixed bugs

  • Fix invalid TOML from commented multi-line values by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1081
  • Deliver the whole document to a root Unmarshaler (#994) by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1083
  • fix: report table placement errors with position and key context by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1086
  • fix: do not recurse forever on recursively embedded structs by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1087
  • fix: error instead of panic on nil unexported embedded pointer by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1089
  • fix: bound array and inline table nesting depth to prevent stack-overflow DoS by @​pelletier in pelletier/go-toml#1092

Documentation

  • unstable/kind: drop duplicate 'a' from LocalDate comment by @​c-tonneslan in pelletier/go-toml#1062

Other changes

  • perf: avoid interface boxing when decoding date/time values by @​nishantmehta in pelletier/go-toml#1085

New Contributors

  • @​nishantmehta made their first contribution in pelletier/go-toml#1085
  • @​c-tonneslan made their first contribution in pelletier/go-toml#1062

Full Changelog: https://github.com/pelletier/go-toml/compare/v2.4.2...v2.4.3

Commits
  • 071a36c fix: bound array and inline table nesting depth to prevent stack-overflow DoS...
  • 57fec25 Add RawMessage marshal support to unstable (#1084)
  • 79f82e3 fix: error instead of panic on nil unexported embedded pointer (#1089)
  • a28afed unstable/kind: drop duplicate 'a' from LocalDate comment (#1062)
  • 6fa69af fix: do not recurse forever on recursively embedded structs (#1087)
  • 82b792e fix: report table placement errors with position and key context (#1086)
  • f93de50 perf: avoid interface boxing when decoding date/time values (#1085)
  • 21f8286 Deliver the whole document to a root Unmarshaler (#994) (#1083)
  • 98e94ae Update bundled toml.abnf to TOML 1.1.0 and pin spec-corner behaviour (#1082)
  • 35f78d5 Fix invalid TOML from commented multi-line values (#1081)
  • See full diff in compare view
